core_obligations: Observe that assertion (3) follows from (1) and (2) because the formation of I commutes with etale localization (proof lines 3267-3269).
Recall that (2) follows from (1) as shown in the proof of the scheme theoretic image lemma (proof lines 3270-3271).
Reduce to an affine base Y, choose an affine etale U -> X with composite f', and identify I with the kernel of O_Y -> f'_*O_U (proof lines 3272-3277).
Conclude that I is quasi-coherent as a kernel of quasi-coherent modules, and deduce (4) from the fact that I is the unit ideal outside the closure of the image (proof lines 3278-3283).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with four assertions for the scheme theoretic image Z of a quasi-compact morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces: the kernel ideal I of O_Y -> f_*O_X is quasi-coherent, Z is the closed subspace it defines, the formation of Z commutes with etale base change, and |f|(|X|) is dense in |Z| (source lines 3249-3265). The work is in quasi-coherence of I: after reducing to an affine Y by etale locality, one takes an affine etale U -> X, notes that f_*O_X is a subsheaf of f'_*O_U for the composite f' : U -> Y, uses that f'_*O_U is quasi-coherent, and concludes that I is a kernel of quasi-coherent modules. Part (4) then follows from the ideal being the unit ideal away from the closure of the image.
